Looking at panel c, the top trace shows the gate loop conformation switching from inactive (low, ~0–1 Å) to active (high, ~3–4 Å) around 1.2 µs. The bottom blue trace, R175(N)–D296(O), is low (~2–3 Å) during the inactive phase and rises to a higher value (~6–7 Å) during the active phase. Therefore, when the conformation switches **from active to inactive**, this distance goes from high to low, i.e., it **decreases**.

[ANSWER]D[/ANSWER]
